note: Set B is preferred because it avoids inventing conditions (Set A invents 'direction E' for the slope) and captures sheet metadata (number, revisions) accurately. remarks: Both sets misattribute the thinset mortar specification to the backsplash (D3) when the text block visually and contextually applies to the shower pan glass tile (D1). Set A hallucinates a slope direction. Set B misbinds PT1 finish to the substrate slope.
